title: Backend Software Engineer
raw_text: We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong Python and API development skills. You will design, build, and maintain high-performance asynchronous REST microservices. Required skills: Python, FastAPI or Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git. Preferred skills: Redis caching, AWS, Kubernetes, Celery. Qualifications: B.Tech in Computer Science or related degree. Responsibilities include building scalable services, database design, and integrating external payment gateways.

parsed.title: Backend Software Engineer
qualifications: B.Tech in Computer Science or related degree
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain high-performance asynchronous REST microservices
Optimize PostgreSQL queries and database schemas
Implement robust caching and distributed task queues
Deploy containerized microservices to cloud infrastructure

title: React Frontend Developer
raw_text: Seeking a talented Frontend Developer to build customer-facing web apps. You must have deep expertise in modern React, TypeScript, and responsive UI design. Required skills: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, TailwindCSS or CSS3, HTML5, Git. Preferred skills: Next.js, Redux, Recharts, Jest. Qualifications: Bachelor's in CS or equivalent practical experience. Responsibilities: create modular UI components, optimize web performance, and integrate RESTful backend APIs.

parsed.title: React Frontend Developer
responsibilities: Build reusable, accessible React UI components
Implement state management with Redux or React Context
Optimize frontend bundle sizes and Core Web Vitals

title: Machine Learning Engineer
raw_text: Looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop generative AI and NLP models. Required skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Data Analysis, Git. Preferred skills: HuggingFace, Transformers, Docker, FastAPI, ONNX. Qualifications: B.Tech in CS/IT or AI. Responsibilities: fine-tune transformer models, preprocess large datasets, benchmark model accuracy, and build inference APIs.

parsed.title: Machine Learning Engineer
responsibilities: Fine-tune deep learning and transformer architectures
Evaluate precision, recall, and F1 metrics on test sets
